todevice_transfer_batch_to_device: transfer a batch of tensors to a specified device like GPU or CPU using todevice
to_numpy_convert_tensors_to_numpy: convert pytorch tensors or batches of tensors to numpy arrays using to_numpy
to_cuda_move_tensors_to_gpu: move tensors or batches of tensors to the CUDA GPU device using to_cuda
collate_with_cat_concatenate_tensor_batc: collate and concatenate a list of tensors or dicts of tensors into a single batch
listify_flatten_nested_lists: flatten a nested list of elements into a single flat list using listify
